title: Segment Anything
layout_note: Three panels in a row, each captioned beneath with a letter and a bold keyword: (a) Task, (b) Model, (c) Data. Panel (a) shows the task as inputs-model-output, (b) opens the model box, (c) shows a data-engine loop above a dataset card.
grouping: Panels are separated by whitespace only. In (a) four small square prompt panels (points, box, mask, text) sit in a row gathered by a curly brace into one arrow to a pale-yellow 'model' box, with the image thumbnail entering from the right. In (b) a large pale-yellow container (the same yellow as the model box in (a) and (c)) holds three coloured sub-blocks. In (c) a loop of thin arrows labelled 'annotate' and 'train' joins the yellow model box and a blue rounded 'data' pill; a dashed grey arrow drops from the pill to a large rounded blue card describing the dataset.
shapes_depth: Flat pale fills with thin same-hue outlines, no shadows, serif labels in grey. Prompts are drawn literally inside small black-outlined squares: red and green dots for foreground/background points, a black rectangle for a box, a pale blue blob for a mask, and the words 'cat with black ears' for text. Input and output are photo thumbnails, the output with a translucent blue mask over one object. In (b) the image encoder is a tall green box, the prompt encoder a small purple box and the lightweight mask decoder a wide orange bar across the top. The dataset card holds a bullet list with the first bullet in bold and a photo with many coloured mask overlays.
proposed_highlight: The model keeps one identity colour (pale yellow) wherever it appears across the three panels, and the panel captions bold the keyword and the acronyms (SAM, SA-1B). The four prompt types are depicted as drawings of the prompts themselves rather than named.
lesson: Show a promptable model's interface by drawing every prompt type literally in small identical squares (dots for points, a rectangle for a box, a blob for a mask, the words for text) bracketed into a single input arrow beside the image.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2304.02643); venue ICCV as recorded from Semantic Scholar, the venue's year not verified. 'other' in elements stands for the annotate/train loop arrows of panel (c).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
